I’m asking you to chip in $3 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mgpvf-dsg-email?] to help me defend one of the most competitive House seats in the country.

They know this is one of the most competitive seats in the country – that’s why national election analysts just moved this race to "Toss-up."
They also know control of the House hinges on the outcome of our race.

I’m backed by working people chipping in what they can because they want someone in Congress who understands the challenges they're facing.
That's why your $3 matters.

* $3 helps us fight back against the flood of outside spending and attack ads that are already on the way.
And if enough people step up, even with just a few dollars, we'll have what it takes to win one of the closest races in the country.
So I'm asking: Can you chip in $3 right now to help us defend this seat and keep fighting for working families? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mgpvf-dsg-email?]

subject: 🗳️What's next for Dr. Annie Andrews Senate Campaign?
body:
📣Meet Annie at Miles with the Mayor this Saturday at 8am.

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/51d4a853f813/kathryn-harvey-for-congresscampaign-kickoff-6427032?e=edbde6c9b1)

---
| |
# Life is so much bigger than politics.
---
| |
After the sudden passing of longtime Senator Lindsey Graham a rapid fire Republican Primary contest for his seat has begun. Yesterday, Governor McMaster announced the appointment of Darlene Graham, Lindsey’s sister, as the interim Senator to fill his seat through January 3, 2027. This turn of events has catapulted Dr. Andrews, our Democratic Nominee for Senate, into the spotlight. Listen to her message and read how her race in transforming.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/6oruo9PB_fI?e=edbde6c9b1&c2id=d580cd1bdfbc15e62e8fc86070aa989a)
| [Listen to Annie’s message](https://us.list-manage.com/_39Z6AwRitw?e=edbde6c9b1&c2id=d580cd1bdfbc15e62e8fc86070aa989a)
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/q6XkiGDQRWI?e=edbde6c9b1&c2id=d580cd1bdfbc15e62e8fc86070aa989a)
| |
# What this means for Dr. Andrews campaign
---
| |
**You can’t gerrymander an entire state.** South Carolina isn’t a red or blue state - it’s a non-voting state. We already know the majority of independents in South Carolina are looking for something else to vote for other than Republicans who are hitching themselves to Trump and his agenda. And boy, do we have a ballot full of options. Dr. Andrews and our other statewide candidates also have the energy of 124 house candidates pulling votes from every district in SC to the top of the ticket.
**And nevermind that she is the most disciplined candidate I’ve ever worked with.**
Her core message doesn’t change. She’s been focusing on key issues that impact the majority of South Carolinians (like healthcare) since day one, and that’s what she’ll continue to do.
---
| |
-She will no longer be challenging a 20+ year incumbent.-She handily won the Democratic Primary with 61% of the vote.-She has considerable name recognition and money in the bank.-None of the potential Republican Challengers will come close to Lindsey’s name ID.-Republicans will have to spend a considerable amount of funds in the knock down drag out special election, and whomever comes limping out will have only two months to run.-She will continue to run a disciplined race that focuses on the needs of our state.\- This could be a perfect storm.
---
| |
# Come meet Annie this Saturday in Spartanburg at Miles with the Mayor 8am - 180 Magnolia St.
---
|
---
| |
# Here’s what comes next.
---
| |
-Filing period for US Senate Republican Primary**July 21 to July 28** -Early Voting **August 5-7** -Special statewide Republican primary election Tuesday, **August 11** -Republican Primary runoff Tuesday, **August 25** -General election voter registration deadline **October 4** -Early voting **October 19 - 30** -Election Day Tuesday, **November 3**
[**You can find information on all the candidates in August on the South Carolina Voter Guide.**](https://us.list-manage.com/15vLeBKLSId?e=edbde6c9b1&c2id=d580cd1bdfbc15e62e8fc86070aa989a)
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/4kh9Dfx6Ef2?e=edbde6c9b1&c2id=d580cd1bdfbc15e62e8fc86070aa989a)
| |
# Check out our latest pod on the SC Senate Race
---
| |
Lindsey Graham's sudden death has reshaped South Carolina politics overnight. We discuss what happens next, who could replace him in the U.S. Senate, how the special election process works, and why this moment could change the future of South Carolina politics. We also look at the Republican primary field, the implications for Annie Andrews' campaign, and what voters should expect in the months ahead. The race for Lindsey Graham's Senate seat is already underway, and the decisions made over the next few weeks could shape South Carolina politics for years to come.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/xD_AkarEUns?e=edbde6c9b1&c2id=d580cd1bdfbc15e62e8fc86070aa989a)
| |
# The election breakdown with Bakari Sellers
---
| |

Bakari Sellers joined me to break down the 2026 South Carolina elections, what the primary results revealed, and why building a competitive Democratic Party is a long term strategy rather than a single election cycle. We discuss the senate campaign, legislative races, fundraising, voter turnout, candidate recruitment, and what it will take to compete statewide over the next decade.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/1AL9qEhxD9N?e=edbde6c9b1&c2id=d580cd1bdfbc15e62e8fc86070aa989a)
|
---
| |
# Meet the Democratic women running in 2026 on Aug 20!
---
| | If you live in Spartanburg County you’ll have women to vote for on your ballot from County Council to the US Senate. Join us on Thursday, August 20th at Party Headquarters to meet these trailblazers, learn about their campaigns, and how you can best support them. Tickets will go on sale next week. This event is hosted by the Spartanburg County Democratic Party and proceeds will benefit our Get Out The Vote efforts in 2026.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/159egbxMUfV?e=edbde6c9b1&c2id=d580cd1bdfbc15e62e8fc86070aa989a)
|
---
|
---
| |
**The SC Legislature failed to pass a budget. That’s it. That’s the whole post.**
Fourteen days without a state budget. That's unacceptable. Republicans control South Carolina's government, and they have no excuses. After decades of one-party rule, they still failed to do one of their most basic jobs. South Carolinians deserve leaders who will put our state first.
---

* **Aug 3** SPCDP Meeting 6pm TK Gregg Center: Youth Voices Panel
* **Aug 3** Spartanburg County Delegation Meeting 5:30pm
* **Aug 20** Meet the Dem Women Running for Office in Spartanburg 6pm Party HQ
* **Aug 27** Pacolet Town Hall with Lekesa Whitner and Courtney McClain
* **Sept 14** SPCDP Meeting: Dr. Jermaine Johnson for Governor

Democracy is a participatory sport y’all, but sometimes you need a rest. Stay with me!

name: Rob Bonta
subject: re: Trump’s Justice Department
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ROB BONTA FOR CALIFORNIA ATTORNEY GENERAL 2026 FPPC ID #145642
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-26 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-26]
This week, I led a coalition of 12 state Attorneys General in taking Paramount and Warner Bros. to court to stop their unlawful merger.
Here’s the bottom line: monopolies give too much power to too few people . That’s why we have antitrust laws like the Clayton Act, which has been on the books for more than a century to prevent this exact situation — and which this proposed merger violates.
If you need proof that antitrust enforcement works, just look at California: We are the fourth largest economy in the world AND we have some of the strongest antitrust and consumer protection laws on the books. That’s no coincidence.
Antitrust enforcement is good for the economy, good for consumers, and good for businesses that play by the rules.
So if all of this is true, why is Trump’s Justice Department allowing this massive merger to continue?

It’s a check on billionaires currying favor with the President so he’ll do their bidding and hand-pick winners and losers, bypassing both the law and the meritocracy that makes our economy thrive.

Every time I'm out in the community, I'm reminded why this campaign exists. These conversations in coffee shops, on sidewalks, and in parking lots are not photo ops. They are the work. They are how you build trust, understand what people are dealing with, and earn the right to represent them.

Too much of what we see in Washington is performance. Viral posts, culture war stunts, and constant outrage distract from the fact that everyday problems are not getting solved. While politicians chase attention, families are struggling with rising costs, healthcare access is shrinking, veterans are falling through the cracks, and communities are being pitted against one another.
### **How Do We Beat the Circus?**
One word: **TOGETHER. I 'm running for Congress to get our families a seat at the table. [Are you in?](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/4d103f7d-90c0-47f0-b588-5105cdf5eaee?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

---|---|---
[JOIN MIKE'S MISSION!](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/4d103f7d-90c0-47f0-b588-5105cdf5eaee?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
My campaign is built around a simple idea. **Hometowns over Headlines.** I believe leadership starts by showing up, listening, and doing the unglamorous work of governing. Not yelling. Not posturing. Not turning public service into a spectacle. **I 'm going to serve our communities, and make sure MAGA bootlickers don't get in the way.**
The MAGA circus only works when people feel disconnected and powerless. The way we beat it is not with louder noise. **It is with stronger community.** Neighbors talking to neighbors, organizing locally, and refusing to let outrage politics define our future.
## **We need You.**
[ DONATE $15!](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/4d103f7d-90c0-47f0-b588-5105cdf5eaee?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
We are running a fully people powered campaign. No corporate money. No special interests. body:
Hello, apologies for the error in the email sent earlier tonight.
You can call Governor Shapiro at 717-787-2500 to ask him to end ICE collaboration in Pennsylvania.
---------- Forwarded message ---------
Date: Thu, Jul 16, 2026, 7:12 PM
Subject: Re: ICE murders again. This is not normal.
https://www.apipennsylvania.org [https://www.apipennsylvania.org]
Hi Peter,
[https://secure.everyaction.com/npIH-E4iR0aHxi8U2uZ5kQ2?contactdata=W36gHuv4KkMXaIFcb3xHZ53iCVp78uiKxacoOMhf1PvX20iLsTacAVjX+JtMMEZLTVVM2xdJ0kOGXApyjMuoUzB48atbMDGC2GnBUHVqciklV/I/ANSY3zR0IhXfJj/m1PYNOhSbAzRE/y/FPVxcpSiuFb9vWQzhNeF6RMPQtg4=]
[https://secure.everyaction.com/82Y1BXHF6Uiojy5pDtjPDw2?contactdata=W36gHuv4KkMXaIFcb3xHZ53iCVp78uiKxacoOMhf1PvX20iLsTacAVjX+JtMMEZLTVVM2xdJ0kOGXApyjMuoUzB48atbMDGC2GnBUHVqciklV/I/ANSY3zR0IhXfJj/m1PYNOhSbAzRE/y/FPVxcpSiuFb9vWQzhNeF6RMPQtg4=]
[https://www.nbcphiladelphia.com/news/local/vigil-at-philadelphia-city-hall-calls-for-ice-accountability/4433451/] This week, our communities gathered in rage and grief for vigils [https://www.nbcphiladelphia.com/news/local/vigil-at-philadelphia-city-hall-calls-for-ice-accountability/4433451/] in memory of two men shot and killed by ICE.
Lorenzo Salgado Araujo in Houston was on his way to work when he was murdered. In Maine, ICE agents killed Joan Sebastian Guerrero with his three year old daughter in the backseat. Both were long-time, legal residents in their communities. Nobody’s suspected citizenship status should determine if they live or die. Yet, we have seen over half a dozen murdered by ICE, and 22 dead under ICE’s watch in inhumane detention facilities this year.
This is not normal. But this is the case if we continue to let ICE’s recklessness and violence run amok. Our communities, our neighborhoods, and our streets are not safe as long as ICE remains unchecked.
Right now, millions of Americans live in towns and counties that permit the local government to collaborate with ICE — including neighborhoods across Pennsylvania. We don’t want our local and state resources going to help an out-of-control agency target, harass, and attack our neighbors.
We’re calling on our leaders to be accountable to the communities they serve: Give Governor Shapiro a call at 717-287-2500 to ask him to end ICE collaboration in Pennsylvania. We deserve to live and thrive free from fear and harassment from ICE.
We’re standing in solidarity with communities in Texas and in Maine. We’re mourning with them, and we’re taking action with them on behalf of our neighbors and loved ones. We keep each other safe — and that starts with kicking ICE off our streets.
[https://secure.everyaction.com/npIH-E4iR0aHxi8U2uZ5kQ2?contactdata=W36gHuv4KkMXaIFcb3xHZ53iCVp78uiKxacoOMhf1PvX20iLsTacAVjX+JtMMEZLTVVM2xdJ0kOGXApyjMuoUzB48atbMDGC2GnBUHVqciklV/I/ANSY3zR0IhXfJj/m1PYNOhSbAzRE/y/FPVxcpSiuFb9vWQzhNeF6RMPQtg4=]

In solidarity,
Mohan Seshadri

[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/16nbkMiMX0F?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| | | | | | The Pentagon is about to check every soldier over 30 for testosterone. Pete Hegseth announced it Wednesday, branded it the "High-T Department of War," and [Mark spent the hour with Victory News' Mike Garofalo](https://us.list-manage.com/EEJy4hSYQnY?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e) sorting out whether it's brilliant or nuts.
Meanwhile, a parasite outbreak has spread across 34 states.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/pcR15nIQebo?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| | 💪 **THE "HIGH-T DEPARTMENT OF WAR" IS OFFICIAL**
Screening is mandatory over 30, optional under. Come up low and replacement therapy is on the table, though that part stays the soldier's call.
Mike covers this beat every day, and he thinks it might be Hegseth's best idea yet. Mark dug up a prescription stat buried in Pentagon records that explains why this was even on someone's radar.
We're not printing that number here. You'll want to hear Mark read it out loud.
---
| [STREAM NOW](https://us.list-manage.com/f5ms72f1XLK?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---
| | 🦠 **THE OUTBREAK THAT FOUND THE RONCHETTIS**
The CDC is probing Taco Bell's lettuce for its role in all this. Sounds like somebody else's headline, right up until you hear where it showed up.
Ava's at a debate camp in Michigan. That's the hardest-hit state in the country. What she texted Mark and Krysty late one night, you need to hear for yourself.
**And Mike has a confession about his flight home from DC. Braver man than most.

** ⚖️ **A BULLETPROOF VEST IN A JUSTICE'S BEDROOM**
Amy Coney Barrett told Congress her security detail sent her home with a bulletproof vest during the Dobbs leak. Her 12-year-old son found it, and what he asked her stopped the room cold.
Then came the swatting at her home six weeks ago. One thing kept that morning from going very, very wrong.
Mark also pulls up a chart about Barrett's voting since Dobbs that's making the rounds. He won't tell you what to conclude. But you should see it.
---
| [WATCH NOW](https://us.list-manage.com/vQkVfWpFxbI?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---
| | 🏔️ **THE MARK VS. THE MOUNTAIN SEASON FINALE IS HERE**
Seven episodes, one house at 11,000 feet, and it all comes down to this. There's a disaster right before the finish line, and then the reveal you've been waiting all season for.
Krysty designed every inch of the inside, and you finally get to see it.
Watch it on Pure Flix or Great American, or catch the whole season on Prime Video. Every view gets us closer to season two.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/fhpXLsfhw6D?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
|

Come see us in person! We're hosting the Republican Party of New Mexico's biggest night of the year — a black-tie dinner celebrating America's 250th, Saturday, July 25 at Isleta Resort & Casino.
You'll hear from gubernatorial nominee Gregg Hull, plus a keynote from Nick Shirley, the independent journalist whose undercover investigations have been making national news all year. It's going to be a fun night, and we'd love to see you there.

name: Mary Peltola
subject: First poll showing us down
disclaimer_text: Paid for by McBride for Delaware
body:
We need to respond.
There have been six polls in the six months since I launched this campaign for Alaska’s U.S. Senate seat. We were leading in the first five.
Then, after my opponent and the billionaires and super PACs that back him started spending millions on attack ads against me, **the New York Times/Siena University poll released this month shows us down two points.**
[](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1184?c0=mcb-em-20260716-2.buQBWq&refcode=em20260716-3555&t=1&akid=3555%2E21716%2ENliYAU)
We need your help to respond.
Election forecasters like Cook Political Report, Sabato’s Crystal Ball, Split Ticket, and VoteHub have all called Alaska’s U.S. Senate race a toss-up.
They shifted the race in our favor because they know we can win, and that all eyes are on Alaska this year in what’s shaping up to be the most competitive and consequential race on the Senate map.
They know we can win because Alaskans are fed up with the rigged system that’s pricing us out and threatening our way of life while DC politicians and their donors make themselves richer.
They know we can win because my opponent, Dan Sullivan, is the least popular senator up for reelection, and Alaskans want someone who will fight for their healthcare, jobs, disaster relief, and public media – not gut them.
They know we can win because I’ve won Alaska statewide – _twice_ – against our former governor Sarah Palin, and now we’re building a movement that’s ready to take on the rigged DC system so we can lower costs, save our fisheries, and bring abundance back to our state.
**They know we can win this toss-up Senate race if we can raise the resources needed to overcome the attack ads and get our message out.**
Our fight for fish, family, and freedom resonates in every region of our big, beautiful state – _and in a state as big as Texas, Montana, and California combined, that’s a pretty broad coalition!_
We’re criss-crossing as much of Alaska’s 586,000 square miles as we can to bring every village and every voter into our campaign, and we’re doing all we can to fight back with ads online and on the airwaves.
But this is without a doubt the most expensive state on the map to run a Senate campaign. To win in Alaska means building a strong ground game and winning the screen war – reaching communities on and off the road system, from the Aleutians to Anchorage to the Arctic.
No one ever said flipping Alaska’s Senate seat was going to be easy. But we do know that this is our best chance to do it.
**I know we can pull this off, and here’s why:** If everyone getting this email split a donation between Sarah McBride and my campaign, we’d have enough to match the tens of millions in outside spending from the billionaire-backed super PACs propping up my unpopular opponent.
**[Split a donation today »](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1184?c0=mcb-em-20260716-2.buQBWq&refcode=em20260716-3555&t=2&akid=3555%2E21716%2ENliYAU)**
That’s the power of a grassroots movement. We can win this when we all chip in together.
But not everyone will read this or give today, and that’s okay. But that’s why it’s all the more important that you do. You’ve already made it this far, and I really appreciate it.
Your support makes a huge difference. I’m humbled to have you with me in this campaign for Alaska’s toss-up Senate seat, and even more so in this fight for fish, family, and freedom. 🐟❤️🇺🇸
Let’s go win.
\- Mary
* * *
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is a critical way we communicate with grassroots supporters like you. However, if you would like to change your subscription preferences, here are some options:
* [Receive Fewer Emails](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/signup/receive_fewer_emails/?t=3&akid=3555%2E21716%2ENliYAU)
* [Update Your Information](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/signup/update_your_information/?t=4&akid=3555%2E21716%2ENliYAU)
* [Unsubscribe](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=5&akid=3555%2E21716%2ENliYAU)

Email us: [info@sarahmcbride.com](mailto:info@sarahmcbride.com)

body:
There’s been a lot of speculation about what Trump will say in his speech tonight.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260716-2&t=1&akid=3736%2E587540%2EXo16fr)
Peter,
In a couple hours, Trump will take the stage in Georgia for a speech in which he promises to reveal “really big news” on election security.
But we know what this speech is really about — a way for him to do whatever it takes to distract, divide, and keep people from focusing on what really matters in this moment.
We don’t know exactly what he’ll say tonight, but we can bet that he’ll spread more irresponsible, conspiratorial lies about the security of America’s electoral system. Because when someone like Donald Trump is afraid they’re about to lose, their last resort is to call the whole game into question.
But honestly? Regardless of what Trump says, our mission stays the same. We can’t afford to lose focus or fall into despair while he manufactures chaos in the final months before the midterms.
**So tonight, I’ll be thinking about two things:**
🔴 Defeating Republicans in red-to-blue races to break the GOP’s grip on power in state legislatures and in Congress — with our candidates like **Randy Villegas** (CA-22), **Tim Hayes** (PA-HD-143), **Trevor Jung** (WI-SD-21), and **Kristian Carranza** (TX-HD-118).
🔵 Primarying asleep-at-the-wheel Democrats by backing young, bold progressives who will meet this moment with the energy and fight it demands — with our candidates like **Patrick Roath** (MA-08), **Donovan McKinney** (MI-13), and **Mai Vang** (CA-07).
That’s the work. That’s always been the work. And no speech, no matter how loud it is, changes that.

name: Tim,  Team Lanier
subject: I'm Tim Lanier and I need you to read this
body:
| | | Hi Friend,
I encourage each of you to keep fighting the good fight. The next few months can define the future of our party in this State and I'm tired of going 0-fer at the ballot box.
I've focused my campaign on building deep roots with county parties, state candidates and the down ballot candidates. I've done so particularly in counties that are underperforming or need a little help.
Recently, I've spent my time in your counties talking about how WE win, now and especially later. I've spent my time actively signing people up to run for county offices and I've promised to be their first campaign manager.
For Bledsoe, Sequatchie, Marion, and Cannon y'all know this because I've gotten Dems committed to run in the next election cycle in front of you. I've followed up with most of them (13 so far!!) and I'll make sure they're ready to go when the time comes. Right now is the best time to think and recruit talent for the next election, even if nobody else is doing it. I'll get these people involved in the general election to learn the ropes.
I'm also trying to SHOW what real leadership should look like. It's not stump speeches and $, it's getting people excited then getting them organized. It's taking action on their behalf.
That's why I'm the best Dem candidate in our field of 5, plus my work ethic and moral compass. I'd like to be our first nominee to the US House in the new 4th district. I won't let you down. It will be much easier to recruit and organize the people of the 4th if I'm the candidate. But I will continue my mission either way, the fight is too important.
I ask that you forward this to your people. Forward to the brass at the TNDP and anyone you think can understand and support me. If we keep focusing all our efforts on winning now, we'll never win later.
To anyone reading this, please research what position you can run for in the next election cycle. My name is Tim Lanier and I'm here to help. Reach out via the links below. I'm also asking for your vote starting Friday July 17th. I'm 4th on the Democratic ballot and I will make tomorrow a little better than today.
💙 Love y'all, Tim

Friend, Donald Trump just delivered a primetime address to the nation, where he peddled conspiracy theories about voting in America, just as he has peddled lies about our elections here in Georgia for years.

Peter,

In just a moment, we are going to ask you to fund our ballot chasers in Arizona. Please give us a chance to explain why this request – _especially today_ – is so important.

Here is the truth:

Arizona's primary election is July 21st. Early voting is already underway, and every single day between now and then matters. _We have to get our ballot chasers in front of voters right now, while there's still time to make a difference_.

Now here is why this actually matters:

**Arizona isn't just another swing state. It's the single most important state on the map.** The state carries 11 electoral votes, soon to be 12, and without winning it, most of the realistic paths to the White House disappear. If Arizona doesn't hold, the odds of keeping America First in power collapse with it.

That's not a talking point. That's math.

Winning Arizona now doesn't just decide one election. It protects Republican pathways in 2028 and beyond, and it's the difference between building on President Trump's mandate or watching it get erased.

But we need to fund the ballot chasers who make it happen. Right now.

Every $50 we raise sponsors a ballot chaser for a single day in the field – knocking on doors, building real relationships, and chasing every ballot before July 21st.

Contribute $50 to make sure the radical left does not steal the election.

Contribute $50 because every dollar goes directly to boots on the ground in Arizona – not consultants, not TV ads.

# Friday, July 17, 2026
---|---

## House Sets Cash-Rounding Rules for Stores
The House passed what it called "the Common Cents Act" by voice vote, setting [national rules for rounding cash transactions](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFuwyAURb8Gb0QYMNgDQxdv6drRIvAcXvsMlsGJ8vdV-gudr3SPzvm6LlePhPn-6TdwbS1LhmclaA2OpR3ntkcI5GvFFSoQhIYl4yKFNFxY3tsleqTXorvoVgAJqgPX21HLUY593yU3RH0TYhz9EAyAMCZqpUZrp6CUkavv0L3fhO1tL4QZxEWFOAklYPXK6MlLpgVEbOW4fBfMLcFKr_KA4xLK1pFLre2VqQ8mZybnliAh0Xtjck5lg7cQk_MwWSG14WfloZwU-R0a9zzDk2cMP0D8zBEOfkMivvtaIfLbi7cEPJWzApNzd7i4P5EIq7FMi_vm8Y_UtX-lezj5GwAA___0r4K0) to the nearest nickel and legally ending penny production in the U.S. Under the new bill, if an amount has 1, 2, 6, or 7 as the last cent digit, it can generally [be rounded down ](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L-K8zAQBPCnkTuH1Vqx4kLF17jL115phLSO99AfY20S8vaH7xWuGxiYH8zXfbl7Tlwe_30mJ2tdCr1bIhE6FjmeeY8Ukm-NV2qUKAjXwgsCjj3YXtslek6fxXTRrURIQ0dO25vBG9607jZHo9XXEeKAeoUpGqPNOEVD0U_ewwAdu3MNrLYaYLzCZQhxggFo9cNoJo_KAEWWely-KxfZaE2f-qLjEmrukttE9qaGfwpnhbNwprNQOPtDOCRSOJ-AwhmswlmfKdSca-kDFWm9D9Jv9dmo331r_U6lfBTO3eHi_uaUuI1WGXhkz-nXlD8d9XL4EwAA__8KEXqq)to the nearest nickel. On the other hand, if an amount ends with 3, 4, 8, or 9 as the last cent digit, it can be rounded up. The legislation also authorizes the Treasury to test a redesigned, lower-cost nickel made with zinc instead of the current copper-heavy alloy. Currently, every 5-cent nickel cost nearly 14 cents to produce last year, and the U.S. Mint lost roughly $18 million on nickel production alone.

## At Least 1 Dead in Hill Country Flooding
At least [two people died](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOpDAMhp8mdEFJFghTpLiGbq-9EnmIA9EFgmKz7Lz9KXOPsJUt2f5_f_-fz_kTYorH-ht2dPwd8nzgTQmZscxbTGnJ18HlFVLOnu54rMT5nI0yg1RWajt7iOk1d413T-UfukGn7diZcdDaNpszIahn6JUfDBoPD9_33WNUAaDrDX7oJroqpqy2Wivd963Bxftx8RjsU4MH0Sn0kXNpeUPGb6CQXvkLS7vkvUluYz5JfPwSZhJmuu-7_UvAdSjMVGlqAY75gCTMVN2EmZQVZtK1e0vKN2A8VklXWZFkKHmX27WiLBAP4lx2kkCyIC0XFpLnlZI8MZ8J_y-XSPX-BsZSPZvi_HnHlCINVnRq3SGm98_8s6S_nPkXAAD__1-aloo) in Central Texas as catastrophic flash flooding swept the Texas Hill Country, a year after the region's deadly July 2025 floods. The Guadalupe River crested at a [near-historic 37 feet](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2SgyAUhZ8GOx24ISIFxTZ22XZLB-WqzBLJwE3Qt9_RV9juFOdnvvPzGB7WB78t3_aJhvY5DhuWHJAI07D6EKb43igdc4jR5eK3JVN8DcChrbmqhRqc9eEYZOXMyJ0WFRqhOgldK4SqVgNyvHGhAVqtAfVN6k5pp1s5o1Sgx8qbs4wroYTg4n5vACfnusnhrEZhnWWSo_MUU0MrEu42z-GIH0zNFJ9VMCvRK7PbF4OeQV9Kaea4yxPjNDDoT8mgv6L1BeK3pf7FlOqL7qjxY6e3JR-3XCXjXsWH4HOrmOTL0_pwLdH__vkY-AsAAP__1id83g), and the gauge downstream at Center Point [rose 32 feet](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2OqzAQhZ_GdI48DmAoXNyGLrfdEjnMAJYmOLInf2-_IlntC2x9Zo7O932dxlOIHLflf7iQl-ecxo0ehUmE8rhG5indNsmvmVPC8ojbUiRdR2tsq43T4EYMkV9jXaE_G-yhIg-uq23XArhq9eeAfd3aBnoLAE03h-Ac4nEy0Lupwyr6vcw4cAAGmuZgaULsJqTZnSFgULUhjJLyQVYSeoYy8yvdKR-mdKnYryLXoo7_lB2UHUrYwrYQJ4532i-UHXakT6Q_mbLDL0Gr7PBu1Tuu_uHVaxQdtiQrZY37V063ot8aquzx-ojMsbRO1Wa5hMjvMfI3hXdvvwMAAP__XgSIMw) in four hours. The National Weather Service warned of a "large and deadly flood wave" moving toward Comfort. Up to [20 inches of rain](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0DvO5CAQBODT4IwRjR-MA4JNnP2bbmi1oW0jYbCg5-Hbr2au8Mclfaqqfz_zD4YY0vYXD7L8XvOc6FUjMVOZ9xCjy4_E5Vpjzr6-Qtoq53PWSg9SGQlm9hjiNXeNt4vyIzRkwdw7fR8ATLPbHjrsFEDfEriFVmyV1wvSsIJp_dI3wX4wZcAAKOj7mybn_d15Ws0C6FF0inzgXG68E9Mb6xqv_KRyc_loot2ZzyraP0JPQk-4OGg_idBT5Vwuoac1Yt3ld4Kkg8pGyV0yO_coJaRNVjxIfmVZaAs5SYfHKY-rcnCSC27kPw6MPYztaISemmL9-QoxhjoY0antwBC_hfh3Nz6t_h8AAP__N2iJ2Q) fell near Uvalde in 48 hours, roughly six months' worth, and rescuers pulled people from homes and vehicles in Hunt, Kerrville, Uvalde, and Knippa. Gov. Greg Abbott said disaster declarations covered 59 counties, with more than 1,300 state personnel deployed. "_We are dealing with and responding to a flood that is likely going to break records_ ," he said Wednesday.
## Abbott Pitches Insurance Cost Relief
Gov. Greg Abbott proposed a $400 million taxpayer-funded grant program to provide Texas homeowners [with up to $10,000](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0Luu8yAQBOCnsTsiwBfiguJv3OVvT2mtYR0jYdaCJZe3P0pe4fTfjEbzc1tuEGJI9_9woOXXRkvCZ4nIjHnZQ4yOauL83iKRL8-Q7oXpXLTUo5BGKLN4CPG99K23q_STatEqc-31dVTKtLs1IFUnjeuGbZzM2K8KB-wmwGnoN2_6NthPmTTKKCXVMFw0Ou-vzuNmVgUeml6iD0z5wjsyvqBs8U0PzBdHRxvtznyWpvvX6LnR8xeslD3mtZaQsJSPa_QM60rMoqYHhljEGSEJ3oGFoxq9cJXFNyx2OlBA8gIqkwip1AzJoXBUuDR6brP15zPEGMpoml7eDwjxO4b_duHD6t8AAAD___1uisY) to help fortify their roofs against hail and wind, part of a legislative push he says will bring down insurance premiums. Speaking Wednesday at a [Houston campaign stop](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGysyAUhJ9GOxxAI6ag-Bu7_O0tHYSDMkFOBo4xvv0d8wq33_1m9_t5TA8TYkjLf7OBpo_HKcFRIhBBntYQo8U9UT59RHTlCGkphK9JctkzrphQkzMhnlNXOz1zdxc1aKGGTg69EKpetVJybr0R3A73Wag7dNxbI1vbtX3bc1UHfcG4EkoILm63RoJ1brAOvJqFcabqOLhAmBtageBjio8nviE3Frc66pXoVar2XyXHSo7HcTQeP7JfcS-E6QpVcrxeVXJcrl7CzMw8IxEzKeGeLBSWIQbw7MtnK26AR4JcmDcWWHmeGe0TKKSFhVT2bJIFZrFQqbN2ryPEGEqvqo4vmwnxO43-JvSt5W8AAAD__9f-kKs), Abbott said Texas ranks first nationally in hail damage and hail insurance claims, and that similar roof programs in states like Louisiana and Oklahoma cut premiums about 8%. The Legislature would review those programs before appropriating funding. House Speaker Dustin Burrows [called the roof plan](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0DGu4jAQgOHTOB3IM8QZp3CxW6Rjq5V2u8jYE2LJxMgeCNz-iXeF1_7FV_z_zvPZp5y26x9_Yyevpcwb7y2zCNd5TTmH8tikvpdcSmx72q5Nyn1GjcNB0wFojj7l99x30V10HKFjB2R7tAMAdasjG2AYAcCwNkM42REDoqEQAW1k3yX3wTQBAWgw5ogcYrQh8kIX8NGrXnNMUupRVhZ--bbkd3lyPYZy67JbRe5NnX4pnBROr09VOP1-1Fr21v_9r3Bq4uXRFE6oiXoiMicwBsYRremqi_c95ZzaQKrX15tP-ZuWnw15OvwKAAD__yN4cxc) a "great initiative." The governor also wants to change state law so insurers can factor driving records into auto insurance rates, which he said industry estimates show could cut some premiums by as much as 30%. "_Home insurance and auto insurance are equally skyrocketing, and Texans were demanding relief_ ," Abbott said, adding that the combined reforms would save Texans "hundreds of dollars a year, more likely thousands."
## Texas Launches State Wildfire Air Fleet
The Texas A&M Forest Service [announced Thursday](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LHOpCAUBeCnwQ4DjIJTUGxjN9tuaZB7GcmiGLgzjm__x3mFvzvJSb6cnH-P6eFiitvzr1vR0ifkacOjJiTCMi0xJZ9fG5UzpJyhHnF7Vsr7pITSXBguzQQupnPqGrCzgLts0EozdGrQUppmsaHrUA5aa3EPnYH-BuiHfkYACVrfsYn2woSRRkoh-75V6AEGDxjMLB041gmESLm0tCDhx9WQzvzG0vq8NskuRHtltz9MjUyNx3G0_6ngVTI1XjZTozBMjfJKX4C7lYdcsBKvWN7RI59fZ-WKL5iizzthqTy51-YXfsQEIRbkLhZfXCAeEiIxNTbFwn7ElGLVhnXiubqYvqvod1--rfoJAAD__x_piyo) it has purchased two helicopters, the first aircraft in a state-mandated wildland firefighting fleet. The first Subaru Bell 412EPX is [due to arrive in December 2027](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGSgyAYhJ8GOxwgKqaguMYu117pIPwocwgO_Anx7W_MK1z9zbc7uz-P-aF98HH91jsofLs0R6glACLkefMhmPSMmE8XUrKl-rgWTMcsmBgok5TL2WofzrlrrFqYvfMGFJdjJ8aBc9lsSsgBuJSOWTaMYrmzgbPe9dIs_c1KA41XVxiTXHLOeN-3Aoy1o7Hg5MK11aRjYD2m3OIGCG9dXDjTC3Jr0t4EtSEehdy-iJiImGqt7e9bxwsSMV1riJg-GhGT3qlLGQrSrOMKudDleVKsiWqfTdYOL06dz0AzlCPFApfXZGWP6kPwZZCkY-uuffj04_9eeynxFwAA__8qroSx), with the second following three to six months later. The purchase kicks off a two-year expansion, funded by the Legislature's 2025 appropriation of $257 million, that will add multimission fixed-wing planes and large airtankers. The agency and local fire departments responded to 6,304 wildfires that burned 132,366 acres in 2025, and the Forest Service delivered more than 1 million gallons of water and fire retardant during those responses. Its aerial partnership with the Texas Military Department will continue while the fleet comes online. The agency calls the fleet's objective simple: get aircraft on a fire as quickly as possible. "_This is a force multiplier for our state's wildfire preparedness_ ," said Forest Service Fire Chief Jared Karns.
